title: Diwali Dhamaal by Desi Vibes Seattle
description: Desi Vibes presents Seattle's biggest Diwali party featuring Seattle's greatest Desi DJs, open bar, and a vibrant, festive celebration.
long_description:
Desi Vibes presents Seattle's biggest Diwali party featuring Seattle's greatest Desi DJs, open bar, and a vibrant, festive celebration.

About this Event

Our 4th year of hosting Seattle's top Diwali party! In Seattle's expansive Ora Nightclub, we bring a festive South Asian experience with a level up from our previous events. Dance away with Seattle's top Desi DJs (Opener Sync Sultan and Headliners DJ Jay and DJ Vibezz). Not to mention a 360 photobooth and a OPEN BAR for the first hour!
Desi Vibes Seattle is a nonprofit community for young South Asians (age 21-35) in the Puget Sound region. 

Also check out other in Seattle.
